congestion_backlog.sql: SELECT upgrade_priority, count(*) AS cells, round(avg(p95_utilization), 3) AS avg_p95_utilization, sum(congested_hours) AS congested_hours FROM lake.gold.cell_congestion_ranking GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

busiest_cities_evening_peak.sql: SELECT city, round(avg(utilization), 3) AS avg_util_19_22h, count_if(is_congested) AS congested_cell_hours FROM lake.gold.cell_hourly_load WHERE hour(hour_ts) BETWEEN 19 AND 22 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

usage_by_segment.sql: SELECT segment, count(DISTINCT subscriber_id) AS subscribers, round(sum(voice_minutes) / count(DISTINCT subscriber_id), 1) AS minutes_per_sub, round(sum(data_mb) / count(DISTINCT subscriber_id) / 1024, 2) AS gb_per_sub, round(sum(dropped_calls) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(voice_calls), 0), 2) AS drop_pct FROM lake.gold.daily_subscriber_usage GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC

quarantine_by_reason.sql: SELECT feed, reason, count(*) AS records FROM lake.silver.quarantine GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

time_travel_in_trino.sql: SELECT 'first build (snapshot 1035650361873718545)' AS version, count(*) AS subscriber_days, sum(voice_calls) AS voice_calls, sum(charge_try) AS charge_try FROM lake.gold.daily_subscriber_usage FOR VERSION AS OF 1035650361873718545 UNION ALL SELECT 'current (after corrections)', count(*), sum(voice_calls), sum(charge_try) FROM lake.gold.daily_subscriber_usage

dq_history.sql: SELECT date_format(run_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS run, count(*) AS rules, count_if(passed) AS passed FROM lake.ops.dq_results GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

churn_score_deciles.sql: SELECT ntile AS decile, count(*) AS subscribers, round(avg(churn_risk_score), 3) AS avg_score, round(avg(usage_trend), 3) AS avg_usage_trend FROM (SELECT *, ntile(10) OVER (ORDER BY churn_risk_score DESC) AS ntile FROM lake.gold.churn_features) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
